name: Ethos Space Resources
long_description: Ethos makes silicon on the Moon to power terawatt scale data centers. The Moon's surface is 21% silicon. We melt and electrolyze the lunar surface to make raw materials for solar panels. With solar panels made from the Moon, the constraint that limits data center scaling and everything else in space is gone.
one_liner: We make silicon on the Moon, to power everything in space.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Lunar resource geologist. Founder of Planetary Sunshade Institute. Kardashev scaling since 2015.

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio: Employee #23 at SpaceX. Designed and built the 2nd stage engine for Falcon 1 as well as many elements of the Dragon spacecraft, including the primary heat shield, Draco thrusters, and more. Later co-founder & CTO at Hyperloop One and co-founder & CEO at Arrivo. Earlier engineering roles at Northrop Grumman and Chrysler Motors.

launches.title: Ethos Space Resources
launches.tagline: Silicon on the Moon for Terawatts in Space
launches.body:
**TL;DR**

**Team**

Brogan was employee #23 at SpaceX. He built the first Falcon and Dragon. Previously, he founded Hyperloop and Arrivo.

Ross is a lunar geologist from the Colorado School of Mines. He previously founded the Planetary Sunshade Institute.

**Problem**

There is infinite power in space. But rockets can’t carry enough solar panels. Rockets are the constraint.

<https://youtu.be/PsxbpAYPtDY>

**Solution**

Power in space must be made in space. Self replicating power and mass relieves the rocket constraint.

The Moon is made of Silicon (and other useful atoms). Silicon makes solar panels (and compute). Solar panels make energy, to refine more silicon and power more compute.

<https://youtu.be/SZjJQqCew70>

**Traction**

* Completed NASA contract
* $1B LOIs from multiple customers
* Going to the Moon in 2028

**Why now**

Capital needs from Earth will diminish as self-replicating power and mass grows on the Moon. Moving up the Kardashev scale will be a matter of wattage and tonnage, not dollars. If you’re not early to self-replication, you’re too late.
